jcr:content.jcr:description: A proof of concept demonstrating Apache Solr integration with Adobe Experience Manager.
jcr:content.jcr:title: AEM Solr Integration

intro.text: This proof of concept demonstrates how Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) content can be prepared for Apache Solr search and indexing. It provides distinct, structured site content for testing content search, relevance, and integration workflows.

search-focus.text: Explore AEM products, services, Cloud migration, and content management topics. The sample pages intentionally use searchable terms such as AEM, Solr, search, indexing, Adobe Experience Manager, content, and integration in natural business context.
